# JTT Icons — Full AI Reference

This document explains how agents should discover and consume JTT Icons. Canonical semantic data remains in `/metadata/icons.json`.

## Selection contract

Use this order when resolving an icon request:

1. Match the requested concept to `name` and `title`.
2. Expand with `tags` and `aliases`.
3. Use `contexts` to distinguish similar concepts.
4. Use `related` when the user asks for a nearby or paired concept.
5. Prefer the canonical `name` in generated code.

## Canonical rendering

- Family: Line.
- ViewBox: `0 0 24 24`.
- Default colour: `currentColor`.
- Line stroke: 2.
- Line caps/joins: round.
- Line fill: none.
- Brand marks may use currentColor fill when the brand silhouette requires it.

- `arrow-up-right` — Arrow Up Right · navigation · interactive · arrow, direction, external, diagonal, up, right · SVG: `/icons/navigation/arrow-up-right.svg`
- `check` — Check · actions · status · check, confirm, done, success, tick · SVG: `/icons/actions/check.svg`
- `code` — Code · developer · meaningful · code, developer, programming, source · SVG: `/icons/developer/code.svg`
- `github` — GitHub · brands · brand · github, git, developer, code · SVG: `/icons/brands/github.svg`
- `heart` — Heart · communication · interactive · heart, like, favourite, favorite, reaction · SVG: `/icons/communication/heart.svg`
- `menu` — Menu · navigation · interactive · menu, navigation, hamburger · SVG: `/icons/navigation/menu.svg`
- `minus` — Minus · actions · interactive · subtract, remove, less, minus · SVG: `/icons/actions/minus.svg`
- `plus` — Plus · actions · interactive · add, create, new, plus · SVG: `/icons/actions/plus.svg`
- `search` — Search · navigation · interactive · search, find, lookup, magnify · SVG: `/icons/navigation/search.svg`
- `settings` — Settings · system · interactive · settings, gear, configuration, preferences · SVG: `/icons/system/settings.svg`
- `star` — Star · communication · interactive · star, favorite, favourite, rating · SVG: `/icons/communication/star.svg`
- `x` — X · actions · interactive · close, dismiss, remove, cancel, x · SVG: `/icons/actions/x.svg`

## Consumption

- Raw SVG: resolve the `path` field against https://icons.byjtt.com.
- JavaScript package: `@byjtt/icons`.
- Public catalogue: https://icons.byjtt.com/icons.json
- Stable API catalogue: https://icons.byjtt.com/api/icons.json

Never invent a JTT icon name. If no canonical concept exists, say so or choose the closest documented related concept.
